title: MARS: A Momentum-Aware Adaptive Rating System for Personalized Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2610.21685v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adaptive assessment systems personalize learning by estimating learner proficiency and recommending suitable questions. However, many existing approaches rely on fixed difficulty labels, static rating updates, or black-box prediction models that provide limited control over rating stability, interpretability, and time-constrained routing. This paper proposes MARS, a Momentum-Aware Adaptive Rating System for interpretable adaptive assessment. MARS represents the question bank as a directed weighted knowledge graph and updates learner proficiency using dynamic rating sensitivity, response quality, and momentum-aware learner velocity. We also formulate a time-budgeted mark-maximization objective in which the policy selects questions within a fixed test duration under negative marking. translated_title: MARS：一种面向个性化评估的动量感知自适应评分系统
translated_abstract: 自适应评估系统通过估计学习者能力水平并推荐合适的题目来实现个性化学习。然而，许多现有方法依赖固定的难度标签、静态的评分更新机制，或黑盒预测模型，这些方法在评分稳定性、可解释性以及时间受限的题目路由方面提供的控制能力有限。本文提出了MARS，一种用于可解释自适应评估的动量感知自适应评分系统。MARS将题库表示为有向加权知识图谱，并利用动态评分敏感度、作答质量以及动量感知的学习者速度来更新学习者能力水平。我们还构建了一个时间预算内的得分最大化目标，使策略在固定的考试时长内、在答错扣分的负分惩罚机制下选择题目。在ASSISTments 2009和MARS-SimExam数据集上的实验从预测能力、评分稳定性和自适应路由三方面评估了MARS。结果表明，MARS提供了平滑的评分轨迹（摘要此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了MARS系统，将题库建模为有向加权知识图谱，通过动量感知的学习者速度动态更新能力评分，并优化时间预算内考虑负分惩罚的得分最大化策略，实现可解释的个性化自适应评估。
en_tdlr: MARS is a momentum-aware adaptive rating system that models the question bank as a directed weighted knowledge graph, dynamically updates learner proficiency using momentum-aware learner velocity, and optimizes time-budgeted, negative-marking-aware question selection for interpretable personalized assessment.
